text:
casey: Quick check-in on console IA. I'm exploring an accessibility-first pattern: keep "Models" and "Datasets" discoverable but visually collapse them into a compact parent. Breadcrumbs stay prominent above the canvas. Sketch: https://staging.redwood/design/ia-a11y-first.png

dina: Love the a11y-first take. Two product questions: 1) how do deep links behave (we need stable permalinks), 2) how do we avoid surprising screen reader users with automatic focus steals when route loads?

sam: Routing plan: canonical routes remain `/console/w/:org/models/:id` and `/console/w/:org/datasets/:id`. We'll accept aliased URLs like `/console/w/:org/assets/models/:id` client-side but normalize (no 301) in-app to avoid network redirects for every click. For legacy top-level shortlinks we can add server-side 301s for SEO/old bookmarks:```js
// example redirect table
{ from: '/models/:id', to: '/console/w/:org/models/:id', code: 301 }
{ from: '/datasets/:id', to: '/console/w/:org/datasets/:id', code: 301 }
{ from: '/m/:id', to: '/console/w/:org/models/:id', code: 302 } // temporary
```Deep-link examples: `/console/w/acme/models/123?view=split&panel=metrics#latency` — we should preserve both query and hash on rewrites.

rachel: Accessibility specifics: do NOT move focus on programmatic expansion during route load. Only move focus when the user triggers the expansion (keyboard or click). Announcements: use an `aria-live="polite"` region that announces user-initiated toggles like "Assets expanded, 3 items". For route-driven reveals (landing on a model) announce context via breadcrumb `aria-current="page"`, not by stealing focus.

casey: Good call. Also UX copy: prefer explicit breadcrumb segments (Workspace > Models > MyModel) and show truncated names with full-name tooltips. The left-group label could be concise (Assets) with hover text "Models & Datasets". Dina, any signals from research?

dina: From sessions: people rely on breadcrumbs when they land via external links. They dislike unexpected focus jumps. Recommendation: when a user opens `/models/:id`, auto-expand the relevant left group visually but do not focus it. Provide a small dismissible banner: "You landed on Model X  Show location in navigation" with a CTA that focuses the nav if they want. Track CTA clicks.

sam: Small infra note: we should persist UI state (split panel, active tab) in querystring for shareability. For scroll anchors, use a hydration debounce: wait for layout/render then `scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})` so anchor navigation isn't janky. Also emit a `route:hydrated` event that components can listen to rather than firing scroll immediately.

rachel: Keyboard nav: group header must be tabbable (role="button" or native button), support Space/Enter to toggle, arrow keys to traverse children, and ESC should collapse open groups if focus is inside. Add a "Skip to content" link at top that lands on the canvas. For the live region text, keep it minimal: "Models expanded" / "Models collapsed". Debounce live messages so rapid toggles don't spam screen readers.

casey: Rollout & analytics: plan a phased roll: 1) internal alpha, 2) 2-week staged external with dismissible banner, 3) wider rollout. A/B test labels: 'Assets' vs 'Data & Models' vs 'Models & Datasets' and measure search fallback rate, nav clicks, and banner CTA CTR.

dina: Banner copy draft: "Models and Datasets now live under Assets. Show me where." CTA: "Show me" / secondary "Take tour". Track clicks and whether users then use search instead.

sam: Implementation checklist for me: add client alias mapping for `/assets/*` that rehydrates to canonical routes, server-side 301s for legacy public shortlinks, persist panel state in querystring, add `route:hydrated` event, and ensure anchor scroll happens after hydration. PR incoming.

rachel: I'll add a11y acceptance criteria to the ticket: no programmatic focus steals on route load, live region messages only on user interaction, keyboard traversal specs, skiplink exists, breadcrumb semantics, and screen reader test steps (NVDA/VoiceOver).

casey: Action items summarized: @sam infra tasks, @dina banner + A/B variants, @rachel a11y tests and criteria. Target: alpha on staging next Friday. Any blockers? :thinking_face:

dina: None from product. I'll prepare research tasks and metrics.

sam: No blockers. Will post PR link when ready.

rachel: I'll run the a11y smoke test once the alpha is up.

casey: Thanks team  pinning design and research plan here. We'll reconvene after the alpha to review metrics and any accessibility feedback. :thumbsup:
